title: Polynomial threshold approximation from noise sensitivity
statement: Let $f:\\{−1,1\\}^n\\to\\{−1,1\\}$ and let $0<\\delta\\le1/2$. There is a Boolean function $g$ with a polynomial threshold representation of Fourier degree at most $\\lfloor1/\\delta\\rfloor$, such that $\\lfloor1/\\delta\\rfloor\\le1/\\delta$ and the relative Hamming distance between $f$ and $g$ is at most three times the noise sensitivity of $f$ at noise rate $\\delta$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a Boolean function on the sign cube
